The named precision bounds retain exact discrete results and allow small floating rounding changes; a resolved one-percent gain error, a changed integer count or a changed physical region is not treated as numerical noise. The perturbation reaches only materialized call 1 (skimage.util.montage); its CLI-recorded spread is sensitivity evidence for that workload, not a floor for every other call. No alternative-build or accelerator floor is claimed. The author finalized these source-linked bounds after reviewing the Docker calibration and accepting the explicitly documented scientific scope and remaining calibration limits.
